_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', 'We offer products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2010 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', 'We offer products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2010 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.08x; +58% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.96; conservative 2yr -6%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY08-FY11 ex-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -4.9%/yr (Q1 FY12 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 2.1-yr ex-FY09 median

BULL.desc: EPS +103.5%/yr (FY08-FY11 ex-FY09 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +155.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY11 ex-FY09, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2011-12-02) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.08x (27.6% downside to Bear $22.56 / +330.8% upside to Bull $134.24) | Adj composite 2.55 vs market 1.59: gap +0.96 [UNDERVALUED] | +58% above the EPP floor $19.71 (9x FY12E $2.19) | Conservative 2-yr case: -5.7% total (-2.9%/yr) | At 14.2x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $41.21 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; net revenue +8.9% YoY in Q4 FY11, forward revenues -2.6% to +1.9% (Q1 FY12 revenue guide (Q4 FY11 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
